falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily close in next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern analog relied on a higher low structure; a break below 4950 would violate the key support level from that pattern and invalidate the bottoming thesis, suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies compressed volatility/complacency; sustained VIX elevation above 25 would indicate genuine panic replacing complacency, breaking the pattern of orderly bottoming seen in August 2024 and signaling a regime shift to forced liquidation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further by >15bps from current level (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with steepening yield curve normalization; renewed flattening/inversion would indicate credit stress and recession repricing that contradicts the soft-landing mechanics embedded in the 76% pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
